CONGRANT.TITLE: TX-CIPHER: Texas Cybersecurity Introduction Program for High-school Education and Readiness
CONGRANT.ABSTRACT: The program seeks to develop participants’ critical thinking, problem-solving, and ethical decision-making skills in cybersecurity through hands-on activities, while also building a mentorship structure that cultivates leadership among undergraduate mentors. Collectively, these efforts will strengthen practical cybersecurity skills, expand the cybersecurity education workforce, and establish a scalable outreach model with best practices that can be replicated at other institutions.
